mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_folder WHERE resource_kind=#{kind} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY sort_no,name,id

choose.when: SELECT DISTINCT d.folder_id FROM public.nocode_report_dataset d WHERE d.deleted=0 AND d.folder_id IS NOT NULL AND
choose.otherwise: SELECT DISTINCT d.folder_id FROM public.nocode_report_dashboard d WHERE d.deleted=0 AND d.folder_id IS NOT NULL AND (d.owner_id=#{actor} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_report_resource_acl acl, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(acl.policy_json) member WHERE acl.resource_kind='DASHBOARD' AND acl.resource_id=d.id AND acl.deleted=0 AND ((member->'actions') @> '["VIEW"]'::jsonb OR (member->'actions') @> '["EDIT"]'::jsonb OR (member->'actions') @> '["PUBLISH"]'::jsonb) AND (member->>'principalKind') || ':' || (member->>'principalId') IN #{principal} AND (d.published_version IS NOT NULL OR (member->'actions') @> '["EDIT"]'::jsonb) ))

mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_report_folder SET parent_id=#{row.parentId},name=#{row.name},sort_no=#{row.sortNo}, lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{row.id} AND lock_version=#{expected} AND resource_kind=#{row.resourceKind} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_report_folder WHERE parent_id=#{id} AND resource_kind=#{kind} AND deleted=0) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_report_datasetpublic.nocode_report_dashboard WHERE folder_id=#{id} AND deleted=0)
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_report_folder SET deleted=1,lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND lock_version=#{expected} AND resource_kind=#{kind} AND deleted=0
